characterization_methods: Incident-photon to current conversion efficiency (IPCE) measurements
evidence: The composition of the thin films is investigated with X-ray diffraction and Raman spectroscopy. The type of conduction, n- or p-type, is determined by examining the 305 cm y 1 peak of the Raman spectrum of CuInS. The current–voltage characteristics of the devices are measured in dark and under illumination. The light intensity is calibrated with a photodiode. The photo-response is recorded with a DC Source Meter. The ratio of the observed photocurrent divided by the incident photon flux, uncorrected for reflective losses or optical absorption by the conducting glass electrode, will be denoted the incident photon to current conversion efficiency (IPCE).
